identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study Of Avelumab Alone Or In Combination With Pegylated Liposomal Doxorubicin Versus Pegylated Liposomal Doxorubicin Alone In Patients With Platinum Resistant/Refractory Ovarian Cancer (JAVELIN Ovarian 200)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A PHASE 3, MULTICENTER, RANDOMIZED, OPEN-LABEL STUDY OF AVELUMAB (MSB0010718C) ALONE OR IN COMBINATION WITH PEGYLATED LIPOSOMAL DOXORUBICIN VERSUS PEGYLATED LIPOSOMAL DOXORUBICIN ALONE IN PATIENTS WITH PLATINUM-RESISTANT/REFRACTORY OVARIAN CANCER

interventions.name: avelumab
interventions.description: 10 mg/kg will be given as a 1 hour intravenous infusion (IV) every 2 weeks (Q2W) in 4 week cycles

interventions.name: PLD
interventions.description: PLD (Arm B, Arm C) 40 mg/m2 will be given as a 1 hour IV infusion every 4 weeks (Q4W) in 4 week cycles
